name: GET /api/sign/:token/signed-copy - Download the document as signed
description: Serves a signer their own copy of the document with the signatures captured so far, as the PDF attachment linked from the confirmation email they receive after signing. Deliberately accepts a used or expired token — signing marks the token used — but is gated on that recipient's status being 'signed', so a spent token can download and can never sign again. Edge cases: while the workflow is still active the PDF is rendered on demand and nothing is persisted, so the final signed copy is still generated from the complete set of signatures; once the workflow is complete the stored canonical copy is served instead; a recipient who has not signed is refused; an unknown token is a 404 rather than a 401 because there is no session to reject.

errorCases.when: no signing_tokens row matches the token
the token references a recipient row that no longer exists
the token references a workflow row that no longer exists

errorCases.message: A signed copy becomes available once you have signed this document
errorCases.when: the recipient's status is pending or declined

errorCases.message: Could not produce the signed copy
errorCases.when: the stored file is unreadable or the PDF render fails
